map.输入激光功率、离焦量、光束质量 M² 与焦距，计算聚焦光斑直径、离焦光斑直径与功: Enter laser power, defocus distance, beam quality M squared and focal length to calculate focused spot diameter, defocused spot diameter and power density.
map.衍射极限光斑 d₀ 由波长 λ、焦距 f 与入射光束直径 D 计算；实际焦点受光: The diffraction-limited spot d0 is computed from wavelength lambda, focal length f and incident beam diameter D; the actual focal spot is enlarged by the beam quality M squared; the Rayleigh length zR describes how the defocused spot dz evolves with defocus distance z; power density I is power P divided by spot area.
map.💡 公式：衍射极限 d₀=4λf/(πD)；实际焦点 d=M²·d₀；瑞利长度: Formula: diffraction limit d0 = 4 lambda f / (pi D); actual focus d = M squared times d0; Rayleigh length zR = pi w0 squared / lambda; defocused spot dz = d times sqrt(1 + (z / zR) squared); power density = P / (pi (dz/2) squared).
map.光纤激光器波长约 1070nm，CO₂ 激光器约 10600nm: Fiber laser wavelength is about 1070 nm, CO2 laser about 10600 nm
map.M² 越接近 1 光束质量越好，单模光纤激光 M²≈1.05～1.2: The closer M squared is to 1 the better the beam quality; single-mode fiber laser M squared is about 1.05 to 1.2
map.功率密度 >10⁶ W/cm² 可实现深熔焊（匙孔效应）: Power density above 1e6 W/cm2 enables deep penetration welding (keyhole effect)
map.📚 深度解析：激光焊接光斑计算（焦斑/瑞利长度/功率密度）: In-depth: Laser Welding Spot Calculation (focal spot / Rayleigh length / power density)
map.激光焊工艺调试：由功率、M²、焦距与光束直径算焦斑与功率密度: Laser welding process tuning: compute focal spot and power density from power, M squared, focal length and beam diameter
map.离焦量选择：算不同离焦下的光斑尺寸，平衡熔深与焊缝宽度: Defocus selection: compute spot size at different defocus values to balance penetration depth and weld width
map.焊接模式判定：按功率密度区分热传导焊与深熔焊（匙孔）: Welding mode determination: distinguish conduction welding from deep penetration welding (keyhole) by power density
map.算法：波长换毫米 λ = nm/1e6；衍射极限焦斑 d0 = 4λf/(π×光: Algorithm: wavelength to mm lambda = nm / 1e6; diffraction-limited focal spot d0 = 4 lambda f / (pi times beam diameter); actual focal spot d = M squared times d0; focal radius w0 = d / 2; Rayleigh length zR = pi times w0 squared / lambda; defocused spot dz = d times sqrt(1 + (defocus / zR) squared); spot area = pi times (dz/2) squared; power density = power / area (W/mm2), times 100 gives W/cm2; above 1e6 W/cm2 is deep penetration welding (keyhole), above 1e4 is conduction welding, otherwise insufficient power density.
map.例：2000W、M²=1.2、焦距 120mm、波长 1070nm、光束直径 9: Example: 2000 W, M squared = 1.2, focal length 120 mm, wavelength 1070 nm, beam diameter 9 mm, defocus 0 gives focal spot 21.8 um, Rayleigh length 0.349 mm, defocused spot 21.8 um, area 0.0003732 mm2, power density 5.36e6 W/mm2 (5.36e8 W/cm2), determined as deep penetration welding (keyhole). Changing defocus to +2 mm expands the defocused spot to 126.9 um, area 0.012645 mm2, power density drops to 1.58e5 W/mm2 (1.58e7 W/cm2), still deep penetration welding but with notably shallower penetration.
map.M² 是什么，为什么必须 ≥1？: What is M squared and why must it be at least 1?
map.M² 为光束质量因子，理想基模高斯光束 M²=1，实际激光器 M²>1；M² 越: M squared is the beam quality factor; an ideal fundamental-mode Gaussian beam has M squared = 1, real lasers have M squared greater than 1; a larger M squared means a coarser focal spot and lower power density under the same focusing condition, directly determining whether deep penetration welding can be reached.
map.离焦量正负怎么选？: How to choose positive or negative defocus?
map.正离焦（焦点在工件上方）光斑大、功率密度低，适合拼缝容错与宽焊缝；负离焦（焦点在: Positive defocus (focus above the workpiece) gives a larger spot and lower power density, suitable for seam tolerance and wide welds; negative defocus (focus inside the workpiece) gives greater penetration. In practice a slightly negative defocus is often used to balance penetration and stability.
map.关于「激光焊接光斑计算」: About the Laser Welding Spot Calculator
map.激光焊接光斑计算器，基于高斯光束聚焦公式，结合光束质量 M² 与离焦量，计算焦点: The laser welding spot calculator, based on Gaussian beam focusing formulas combined with beam quality M squared and defocus distance, computes focal and defocused spot diameters, Rayleigh length and power density, and determines the welding mode.
